summary: anylist_search/anylist_execute are read-only: an explicit endpoint allowlist filters search results, and the execute gate fails closed before client construction or any HTTP request for mutation or unclassified routes, directing callers to the anylist-pp-cli command mirror.
reason: The generated code-orchestration dispatch would otherwise let a generic MCP agent POST raw mutation payloads to /data/*/update and related routes with no preview/apply, typed payload, read-after-write, or cache-sync gates. Failing closed keeps write safety owned by the CLI command mirror; a regen that adds new read-only endpoints must consciously extend the allowlist, enforced by code_orch_test.go keeping it in lockstep with endpoint shapes.
